rows: Why is the cache line 64 bytes?
Balances spatial locality benefit vs bandwidth wasted on partial use
What is the cost of an L3 miss?
~100 CPU cycles to DRAM; 4× more if NUMA remote socket
Page table walk: 4 memory accesses → 50–300 cycles
When should you use huge pages?
Large working sets (>1 GB) to reduce TLB pressure
What is a non-temporal store for?
Large sequential writes that you won't re-read — avoid cache pollution
8-way: each cache set has 8 slots; higher associativity = fewer conflict misses
Why does AoS often lose to SoA?
AoS loads unused fields into cache lines; SoA packs accessed fields together
